system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 34. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (40 seconds, code score 0.83) ---
[b00] JUDGE (booming, authoritative): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning."
[b01] SFX: [A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]
[b02] JUDGE (inquisitive, severe): "Do you deny possessing this book?"
[b03] JULIANA (calm, unflinching): "No."
[b04] JUDGE (stern, accusatory): "Do you deny using its remedies?"
[b05] JULIANA (firm): "No."
[b06] JUDGE (hard, pressing): "Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts."
[b07] JULIANA (proud, dignified): "I admit to healing the sick."
[b08] ACTION: The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.
[b09] JUDGE (furious, shouting): "Silence!"
[b10] SFX: [Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
[b11] JUDGE (commanding): "Prudence. You served beside the accused?"
[b12] ACTION: Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.

--- WINDOW 1 (54 seconds, code score 0.83) ---
[b00] JULIANA (proud, dignified): "I admit to healing the sick."
[b01] ACTION: The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.
[b02] JUDGE (furious, shouting): "Silence!"
[b03] SFX: [Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
[b04] JUDGE (commanding): "Prudence. You served beside the accused?"
[b05] ACTION: Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.
[b06] PRUDENCE (trembling, tearful): "Yes, Your Honor."
[b07] JUDGE (probing, formal): "Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?"
[b08] JULIANA (softly, urgent): "Tell the truth."
[b09] PRUDENCE (sobbing, heartbroken): "Yes."
[b10] JUDGE (measured, stern): "What did you see?"
[b11] PRUDENCE (choked with tears): "She used herbs... and her mother's book."
[b12] JUDGE (pressing, sharp): "Did she draw strange markings?"
[b13] PRUDENCE (faltering, desperate): "She... placed herbs around my brother's bed."
[b14] JUDGE (accusatory, forceful): "And did she speak words you could not understand?"
[b15] PRUDENCE (weeping, shaken): "Yes."
[b16] LORD (triumphant, smug): "Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual."
[b17] ACTION: Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.
[b18] JULIANA (passionate, indignant): "It was not a ritual!"

--- WINDOW 2 (20 seconds, code score 0.83) ---
[b00] ACTION: Prudence buries her face in her stained white apron, shuddering with grief.
[b01] JULIANA (passionate, defiant): "Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it."
[b02] ACTION: The Judge furiously smashes his gavel down upon the sound block with a deafening crack.
[b03] SFX: [Violent, resonant smash of the wooden gavel]
[b04] JUDGE (thunderous): "Enough!"
[b05] ACTION: The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.
[b06] JUDGE (booming, solemn): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft..."

--- WINDOW 3 (27 seconds, code score 0.83) ---
[b00] ACTION: The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.
[b01] SFX: [Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]
[b02] JUDGE (bellowing): "You will speak when addressed!"
[b03] LORD (calm, poisonous): "We have further witnesses."
[b04] TOWNSMAN (nervous, fearful): "My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures..."
[b05] JUDGE (sharp): "And?"
[b06] TOWNSMAN (agitated): "She became violently ill."
[b07] OLD WOMAN (shrill, accusatory): "My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!"
[b08] LORD (mocking, smug): "She calls it healing."
[b09] ACTION: The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.
[b10] LORD (resonant, vindicative): "The people call it poisoning!"
[b11] JULIANA (incisive, defiant): "What were their illnesses?"

Pick the single best promo.
